adjudication.rationale: The diff clearly changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` from a single object to an array (`DestinationCalendar | null` -> `DestinationCalendar[] | null`) in `packages/types/Calendar.d.ts` and `packages/core/builders/CalendarEvent/class.ts`, and updates at least one BOOKING_* webhook E2E expectation from `destinationCalendar: null` to `destinationCalendar: []` (`apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts`). That is a breaking schema change for webhook consumers that previously read `payload.destinationCalendar?.integration` / `.externalId` (now `destinationCalendar` is an array, so those properties are undefined unless they index `[0]`). The diff does not show any backward-compat shim (e.g., keeping the old field or duplicating into a new field) or versioning mechanism in the payload, so the compatibility concern is grounded, though whether this is “a bug” vs an intended API-breaking change depends on external contract expectations not shown in the diff.
